title: cacalia alliariae subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Cacalia alliariae subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean cacalia, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Compositae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia alliariae subsp. pyrenaica are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
